summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. (Nasdaq: CMND), a clinical-stage biotech, filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, disclosing a non-binding Letter of Intent to acquire a 51% majority stake in an EV wireless charging company for automated parking. Aggregate purchase price is $2.5 million cash. Additionally, Clearmind will extend a $1.5 million loan to the target at 4% interest, repayable two years after closing. Closing is subject to definitive agreements, due diligence, and conditions. The Acquired Company develops wireless charging up to 10 kW for robotic parking and autonomous platforms. This represents a strategic diversification for Clearmind. What to watch: execution of definitive agreements and due diligence completion.
